chunks: And from one of his sermons (peace be upon him), in which he warns against heedlessness and draws attention to fleeing to God.

key_terms.الْغَفْلَة: Heedlessness, spiritual negligence or forgetfulness of God
key_terms.الْفِرَارِ لِلَّهِ: Fleeing to God, seeking refuge or retreat towards the Divine
key_terms.خُطْبَة: Sermon, a formal discourse or speech

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by fleeing to God from heedlessness?
ai.summary: In this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) characterizes spiritual heedlessness (ghafalah) as a subtle trap that distracts believers from their ultimate return to the Creator. Drawing on Shia exegetical tradition, this exhortation emphasizes that true salvation requires active flight (hijrah) from worldly negligence toward divine proximity, framing death not as an end but as a transition demanding preparedness.
